question_or_proposition: For the qualitative effluent limitation prohibiting discharge of visible films of oil, globules of oil, grease or solids in or on the water and coatings on stream banks, under what discharge conditions does the limitation apply, and does it impose any monitoring or compliance-evidence obligation distinct from numeric DMR parameters?
required_context: Adjacent floating-solids/visible-foam limit ('in other than trace amounts') in the same FLOATING SOLIDS, VISIBLE FOAM AND/OR OILS section
Sample-location sentence immediately following the nominated span ('Samples taken in compliance with the monitoring requirements specified above...')
Footnote *1 'When discharging' from the adjacent monitoring-requirements table
notes: The nominated span is a non-numeric, visual/qualitative effluent prohibition. Purpose A targets enforceable numeric limits, so interpretation is unlikely to change numeric limit applicability. Purposes B and C could change depending on whether this standard applies only when discharge occurs, whether it implies monitoring obligations, and how missing or non-numeric evidence for oil/grease/solids/stream-bank coatings should be classified.
